name: The Underroot
summary: The Underroot is a cave in western Greenshade, southeast of the Seaside Sanctuary containing lamia. The group is led by Domina Ssaranth. According to a Blood-Spattered Love Note found in the cave, The Underroot was not only used as a trysting spot, but the Lamia were thought to be friendly. Two passive senches are found near the boss' room. Snakes and torchbugs are found in number within.
